name: KGMO to KRP-13 Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Gas pipeline branch to KRP-13, KGMO-KRP-13, Khimki-Kryukovo branch

researcher_notes: Not matched to an existing row: roster has no KRP/Khimki/Kryukovo/Dolgoprudny row; P2380 (Ring of the Moscow Region, 365 km, 800 mm) and P2379 (Ring-Belousovo) are the ring and a different radial; P2312 is Gryazovets-KGMO. Add-threshold: (a) sponsor/operator Gazprom transgaz Moskva (Kryukovskoe LPUMG), owner PAO Gazprom: Moscow gov 2016 external gas-supply scheme says trunk-gas objects of PAO Gazprom are operated by OOO Gazprom transgaz Moskva (mos.ru PDF, url_verifier OK); entity_lookup finds no matching entity ('Transgaz' 100 is not this one), so a new Gazprom transgaz Moskva operator entity would be needed on the operators tab. (b) endpoints: KGMO ring tap to KRP-13 in Molzhaninovsky district of Moscow city (only KRP inside Moscow proper per the 2010 scheme App.2 section 'Analiz tekhnicheskogo sostoyaniya KRP'; table lists 'KRP-13, Khimki-Kryukovo (II n.)', in service 1963). (c) concrete step: built and operating (window allows operating lines GEM never captured): Gazprom transgaz Moskva Kryukovskoe LPUMG page lists 'gazoprovody-otvody k KRP-13 i KRP-14' among lines built and commissioned and in its operated zone (Wayback copy of live page, which timed out for url_verifier; fetched and read directly; a 2023 news page on the LPUMG's 60th anniversary says the same). (d) LENGTH: 26.8 km, DN1020, from Table 6.1 'Tekhnicheskie parametry podvodyashchikh gazoprovodov ot KGMO k KRP' of Moscow govt decree 741-PP of 24.08.2010 Appendix 2 (url_verifier OK, read directly; page is cp1251 so the verifier needed the expected string in Cyrillic: '26,8'); >= 25 km by 1.8 km. Same section says the radial KRP lines are mostly double-string: DN1020 plus older reserve 'rezervnye gazoprovody ... postroeny v 60-e gody, diametr 820 mm' (KRP-11, 16, 17 excepted); Appendix 3 of the same decree calls them 'Magistralnye gazoprovody KGMO-KRP-13 P=5,5 MPa Du800 i Du1000' feeding Skhodnya GRS, Lobnya and Dolgoprudny. So the 26.8 km / DN1020 figure is the main string; a DN800 reserve string exists whose length is not stated and is not added (could be a second row if a source gives it). Caveats: the length source is a 2010 decree now marked 'utratilo silu' (lapsed), but it is a technical-parameter table of existing pipe, not a plan; no later source restates it (2016 mos.ru scheme discusses KRP-13 reconstruction to 1500 thousand m3/h but gives no feeder length); the Garant page is a legal-database reproduction of the Moscow government decree, and the Gazprom page is an independent operator source for existence/operator (not for length), hence independent=true for existence/status but length is single-source. Ignore OSM 106.7 km (shared ring ways). KRP-13 design capacity 650 thousand m3/h is the KRP's, not the pipe's, so Capacity left blank; start year not stated for the pipe (KRP 1963) so left blank. Route: not drawn; RouteType/Accuracy set to no-route; an OSM 'Otvod k KRP-13' trace exists in seeds (osm:ovod-k-krp-13) but is merged with ring ways, so it is a candidate for a section-8 route run, not evidence. Tier medium: status via two independent publishers (Moscow government decree + Gazprom operator page); length/diameter one validated ref (2010 decree table).
